summary: Linked-list search by float key. Starts at the head pointer this[11] (offset 0x2C); returns 0 immediately if the list is empty. Walks nodes comparing the float field at node offset 0x8 against the search value a2, following next pointers at node offset 0x14. Returns the first node whose float matches a2, or 0 when the chain ends without a match.

local_names.this: list container holding the head pointer at 0x2C
local_names.a2: float search key compared against each node's value at +0x8
local_names.v2: current node pointer as the chain is walked

operations.description: If the head pointer is null the list is empty; return 0 immediately

When the next-node pointer at offset 0x14 is null the chain is exhausted; return 0 without a match
